subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts a tall green top hat with an orange ribbon band and a small blank card tucked inside, exactly as briefed.

category.why: The top hat floats tilted in the air with no floor or surface beneath, set against a saturated gradient background with radiating sunburst rays.

clean.why: There are no text elements, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with comfortable margins on all sides without crowding or clipping the frame edges.

colour.why: The colours are bright, saturated, and warm, offering high contrast between the green hat and the golden-orange background.

detail.why: The shapes are clean and minimal with no noisy textures, scratches, or micro-details.

style.why: The rendering features smooth chunky 3D volumes, a soft satin sheen, and clean edges consistent with the reference cards.
